stem: Which ending result or final point follows “A file can be copied easily, but legal access is not the same as technical possibility.”?
options: A cleaner future still needs planning, repair, and patience.
Digital libraries are still libraries, with fairness to manage.
He knew that something short can still be beautiful.
A slow step can still be a brave step.
